text: Cycling, a transportation method that has been a part of human culture for a very long time, is an exciting sport that allows individuals to travel to new places while taking in the beautiful surroundings. This sport involves turning the pedals, which engage the back gear, causing the bike to move forward. The back gear is typically attached to the pedal, making it easier to adjust gears. To protect the head, riders wear helmets. They also wear leather covers for comfort and style.
